facts.statement: Andrews first named Tricleidus in 1909, designating Tricleidus seeleyi as the type species.
facts.quote: It was first named by Andrews in 1909 and the type species is Tricleidus seeleyi.

facts.statement: The species T. svalbardensis was transferred to the genus Colymbosaurus in 2012.
facts.quote: One species, T. svalbardensis, was moved into Colymbosaurus in 2012.

facts.statement: Fossils of Tricleidus have been found in the Agardhfjellet Formation in Norway.
facts.quote: It was found in the Agardhfjellet Formation, Norway.

facts.statement: Tricleidus belongs to the family Cryptoclididae.
Tricleidus lived during the Toarcian to Oxfordian stages, between 184.2 and 154.8 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Toarcian to Oxfordian (184.2 to 154.8 million years ago)

facts.statement: There are three recorded fossil occurrences of Tricleidus in the Paleobiology Database.

rejected.statement: Tricleidus is an extinct genus of cryptoclidid plesiosaur known from a single specimen found in the United Kingdom.
rejected.quote: Tricleidus is an extinct genus of cryptoclidid plesiosaur known from only specimen (BMNH R3539) from the middle Jurassic of United Kingdom.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'Tricleidus is an extinct genus of cryptoclidid plesiosaur'
